title: Americans Are Getting Passports Like Never Before
hook: 5% became almost half -- your whole country just broke out.
closing: Half the country's ready to leave. The other half isn't.
question: Do you have a valid passport?

segments.say: Today, 48 percent of Americans own a passport, nearly half the country.
The government issued a record 27.3 million passports in 2025.
New Jersey alone sits at 68 percent -- well above the national average.
